lines.speaker: sparrow_pilot
lines.text: Both dead in the water, both done. Quiet Water lives up to its name. Very quiet. Extremely quiet now.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Never lit an engine again, either of them. That launcher earned its keep. I'm naming it.

lines.speaker: sparrow_pilot
lines.text: Captain, the second wreck is still putting out power. Something in there is recharging itself.
